purpose: Human review queue for the highest-traffic repair/install terminals. Approved drafts become reviewed_knowledge; do not paste customer PII.

priority_terminals.why: Most-reached terminal historically; wrong model video destroys trust
check: Prompt tells customer to match model label before watching
Missing-model fallback does not invent a generic YouTube link

priority_terminals.why: Common remote path including blinking/partial commands
check: Customer text distinguishes blank screen vs partial commands vs cable
Prompt does not promise free replacement before review
Evidence ask is photo/video of remote only
No invented PCB diagnosis in customer copy

priority_terminals.why: Travel noise / ticking while heads move
check: Customer copy stays review-only (no free mech approval)

priority_terminals.why: Noise during massage including high-pitch ticking
check: Backpad/lining checks are documented for staff
Customer copy does not claim the part is already approved

priority_terminals.why: Heads do not move — often hardware
check: Honest handoff: fuse/powercord check then team review
Maps from 'up and down motion has stopped' / Quantum roller language
Free-text synonyms map to no_movement / worked_before_stopped / power_but_no_move
One mismatch then handoff, not endless re-ask

admin_workflow: Open /admin/quality → Submit a knowledge draft per terminal
Include source URL (Freshdesk/OTAsupport) and applicable models
Approve only after a second reviewer checks customer-safe wording
Re-measure confirmed_fix + unknown rate on the release cohort after publish

success_metrics.B_first_answer_match: Terminal/guide reached without re-showing the area menu
success_metrics.C_handoff_followthrough: Unresolved/unable cases get staff receipt within 24h (separate from request saved)
